Envelope descent into a certified floor. For a realized word w at n (follows n w), if n ^ 3^{#O(w)} ≤ N₀ ^ 2^{|w|} as integers then floorPower^[|w|] n ≤ N₀ (iterate_le_of_envelope, from power_bound_word and Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_left); if moreover every 1 ≤ m ≤ N₀ lies in a backward-closed class A, then n ∈ A (mem_of_envelope_floor); in particular, with A = ReachesOne and the realized itinerary of the first k steps, n ^ 3^{#O(itinerary n k)} ≤ N₀ ^ 2^k implies ReachesOne n (reachesOne_of_itinerary_envelope). This is the exact step of the Tao-type reduction: a start whose exponent walk reaches −L(y) = −log₂(log 2y / log N₀) within d steps enters [1, N₀]. Not a halt theorem.

Theorem A of the Tao-reduction note. If for some e > 1 − λ** = 0.5074… and all sufficiently large y, #{n odd in (y, 2y] : n does not reach 1} ≤ y (log y)^{−e}, then every positive integer reaches 1. Proof: every failure lies in the E-tree of an odd failure (forward closure), each E-tree level has log-mass ≤ 2/n₀ and at most 1 + log₂ log x levels meet [1, x], so the log-count of the failure set is ≪ (log x)^{1−e} log log x, contradicting fate contagion (J-fate-log-density) for any λ ∈ (1 − e, λ**). The E-tree bound, the dyadic sum and the contradiction given a contagion lower bound K (log x)^λ are Lean (tao_rate_implies_conjecture in FateTaoReduction.lean); the contagion bound itself (Theorem 5.3) stays a human proof, so this row is not Lean-verified. The same holds for the hypothesis stated over all n in (y, 2y], and in logarithmic form it is Corollary 4.5 of the fate note. A Tao-type almost-all theorem with the bounded target [1, N₀] and rate (log y)^{−0.53} would therefore prove the Juggler conjecture; for the Collatz map the analogous implication fails (thin preimage trees). Not a halt theorem: the hypothesis is not proved.

Theorem B and Corollary C of the Tao-reduction note. Let L(y) = log₂(log 2y / log N₀), d(y) = ⌈C L(y)⌉, p_C = (1 − 1/C)/log₂ 3, e(C) = C D(p_C ‖ 1/2)/ln 2 (Chernoff exponent; e(21) = 0.621, e(25) = 0.812, e(30) = 1.054). The L-bad words of length d ≥ C L (exponent walk never reaching −L) number at most 2^d 2^{−e(C) L}, and the O-rooted ones at most 2^{d−1} 2^{−(e(C)−ε) L} for L large. Under the cylinder bound H(C, A) — every O-rooted L(y)-bad word w of length d(y) has #{n odd in (y, 2y] : word_{d(y)}(n) = w} ≤ 2^{−(d(y)−1)} y/2 + y (log y)^{−A} (the fair share of an O-rooted cylinder among the y/2 odd starts, whose first letter is O), with A > C + e(C) — all but (y/2)(log 2y / log N₀)^{−(e(C)−ε)} odd starts in (y, 2y] enter [1, N₀] within d(y) = O(log log y) steps (envelope descent, J-fate-envelope-floor). Hence H(C, A) with C ≥ 19 (rate threshold 1 − λ** = 0.5074; C ≥ 19 against the V_5 truncation 0.4924, the V_4 truncation 0.4916, the V_3 truncation 0.4891 and the OEOEE truncation 0.4801; C ≥ 20 against the pairing-only root 0.4480; C ≥ 18 against 1 − λ*** = 0.4608) implies the Juggler conjecture through J-tao-rate-implies-conjecture. The depth is O(log log y) because the Juggler descent is by powers (one certificate sends n to n^e); the Collatz analogue would need depth Θ(log y), where cylinders have single elements. Exact walk counts (data/research/juggler/tao_reduction/summary.json) show depth ≈ 17 L(y) would suffice in place of 20 L(y). Census with the certified floor N₀ = 3.5·10^8 as target (tao_census, OBSERVATION): for random odd starts in (y, 2y], y = 10^12 … 10^50, the fraction of exact orbits still above N₀ after d ≤ 40 steps matches the odd-start fair-coin survival P[u_t > −L(y) ∀ t ≤ d | u_1 = log₂ 3 − 1] within 3% for d ≥ 10 (ratios 0.92–1.05): the aggregate odd share along surviving prefixes is 1/2. H(C, A) is the conjecture juggler_loglog_depth_cylinder_bound; depth ≤ 4 is Paper B, depth 5 is the K₃ wall. Not a halt theorem. Scope correction 9 September 2026: the former all-word version is REFUTED by J-absorbed-cylinder; this row uses only the bad-word restriction already present in the Lean union bound.

Theorem B′ of the Tao-reduction note (biased-split form). Let 0 < q < log 2 / log 3 = 0.6309…, μ = 1 − q log₂ 3 > 0, C > 1/μ, e_q(C) = 2 (Cμ − 1)² / (C (log₂ 3)² ln 2) = 1.1486·(Cμ − 1)²/C. Hypothesis H_q(C, A): for all large y, every 1 ≤ t < d(y) = ⌈C L(y)⌉ and every O-rooted L(y)-bad word w of length t, the cylinder [w]_y of odd starts in (y, 2y] sends at most q·#[w]_y + y (log y)^{−A} of its members to an odd next state (one-sided odd-share bound with additive slack), A > C + e_q(C). With only A > C, the proof supplies any rate below min(e_q(C), A-C), not necessarily e_q(C). Then for every ε > 0 and large y, #{n odd in (y, 2y] : n does not reach 1} ≤ (y/2) (log 2y / log N₀)^{−(e_q(C) − ε)}. Proof: append synthetic E letters after the first envelope crossing; on bad prefixes the synthetic word equals the actual word, and on crossed atoms the odd excess is zero. The synthetic exponent walk u_t = o_t log₂ 3 − t has conditional drift ≤ −μ + η_t log₂ 3 with E[Σ η_t] ≤ 4 (log 2y/log N₀)^C (log y)^{−A}; a start not reaching 1 has u_d > −L (envelope descent, J-fate-envelope-floor); Markov on the slack and Azuma–Hoeffding on the martingale part (increment range log₂ 3) give the bound. With Theorem A (J-tao-rate-implies-conjecture): e_q(C) > 1 − λ** = 0.5074 implies the Juggler conjecture; least C: 19 at q = 1/2, 41 at q = 0.55, 223 at q = 0.60, 1586 at q = 0.62. Hence: if no L(y)-bad cylinder of depth below 41 log₂(log 2y / log N₀) sends more than 55% of its members to an odd state, every positive integer reaches 1. Anatomy (exact DP): among fair-coin bad words at (y, d) = (10^100, 75) the fraction containing an odd run ≥ 4 is 0.9999 and ≥ 5 is 0.988, so the hypothesis cannot be met by controlling bounded odd runs — it is the O⁴ → O⁵ split (Conjecture 7.3, K₃) and its iterates. Odd-run census on (10^6, 2·10^6]: the cylinders O^t split with odd-share within binomial noise of 1/2 for t ≤ 14. Not a halt theorem; the hypothesis is not proved. The old all-prefix version is REFUTED by J-unstopped-cylinder-bound; the restricted hypothesis remains unproved.

Theorem B‴ and Proposition 10.1 of the Tao-reduction note (the weakest per-scale form in the displayed hierarchy; see J-pressure-scale-average-suffices for the corrected scale-averaged variant). Let τ(n) be the entrance time of the orbit of n into the certified floor [1, N₀], o_t(n) the number of odd letters among n, …, J^{t−1}(n), d(y) = ⌈C L(y)⌉, a_θ = (1 + e^θ)/2. Live pressure P_θ(C): (1/N) Σ_{n odd in (y,2y], τ(n) > d} e^{θ o_d(n)} ≤ a_θ^d e^{o(d)}. Theorem B‴: P_θ(C) at θ_C = log(p_C/(1 − p_C)) gives #{n odd in (y,2y] : τ(n) > d(y)} ≤ (y/2)(log 2y / log N₀)^{−(e(C) − ε)}, the bound of Theorem B (proof: τ > d ⟹ u_d > −L ⟹ o_d ≥ p_C d, then the exponential Markov inequality; θ p_C − log a_θ = D(p_C ‖ 1/2)); hence P_{θ_C}(C) with C ≥ 19 implies the Juggler conjecture. No-momentum form M_{θ,q}(C): with μ_{θ,t} the measure on live starts with density ∝ e^{θ o_t(n)} and s_θ(t) = μ_{θ,t}(J^t(n) odd) the tilted odd share, Σ_{t<d} (s_θ(t) − q)^+ = o(d) implies P_θ (q = 1/2) and, for 0 < q < p_C < 1, gives #{τ > d} ≤ N exp(−d D(p_C ‖ q)(1 − o(1))) only when M is assumed at the optimizing tilt θ = log(p_C(1-q)/(q(1-p_C))). At an arbitrary positive tilt the exponent is θ p_C − log(1-q+q e^θ), with an o(1) error — at the optimizing tilt the logarithmic rate is C D(p_C ‖ q)/ln 2, at least Azuma’s (least C: 19 at q = 1/2, 41 at 0.55, 214 at 0.60, 1496 at 0.62). The stopping at the floor is essential (J(1) = 1 is odd; the unstopped odd count of every start that reaches 1 grows linearly). Consequences (§10.4): any o(log log y) initial depths are free (each letter costs a factor ≤ e^θ), so K₃ and every fixed-depth split are irrelevant to the reduction; the tower O^t enters only through its tilted weight (β e^θ/a_θ)^{t−1} and is harmless below odd share (1 + e^{−θ})/2 = 0.836 at θ = 0.396 (H_q needs < 0.6309; the conclusion fails only above 2^{−e(C)/C} = 0.981); Walsh sums of order |T| enter the unstopped moment with weight tanh(θ/2)^{|T|}; and no bounded-depth cylinder statement can close the reduction (a word measure fair to depth k and all-O afterwards satisfies every depth-≤ k statement and violates the bound). The wall is the tilted average split of typical odd-heavy live words at depth ≍ log log y, not any individual cylinder. Census (pressure_census, OBSERVATION): s_θ(t) ∈ [0.44, 0.56] for t ≤ 40 at y = 10^12, 10^20, 10^30, 10^50 (40000 exact orbits each), cumulative excess over 1/2 equal to the positive-part noise, live moments within 5–8% of the fair DP. Not a halt theorem; the hypothesis is not proved.

Tao-reduction note §10.4(d), corrected scope 9 September 2026. With D(w)=#[wO]-#[w]/2 and the global collision count C_t=sum_{|w|=t} #[w]^2, Parseval gives sum_w D(w)^2=2^{-t-2} sum_{S subset [0,t)} |W_{S union {t}}|^2=C_{t+1}/2-C_t/4. Thus global Walsh and collision bounds are representations of the same second-moment information, not a new mechanism. A sufficiently strong global pair-correlation estimate implies the almost-all bad-prefix split bound and the corrected bad-cylinder H(C,A); equivalence to that restricted H is no longer asserted. The former unrestricted all-word H is refuted by J-absorbed-cylinder. The live pressure P_theta is unchanged and unproved. Do not re-derive nearby Walsh/correlation formulations as new hypotheses.

Paper C Section 10, corrected 9 September 2026. For odd n, n is a failure iff its orbit never enters the certified interval [1,N₀]. With x = exp(t), the normalized free term is ψ_F(t) = q_OO(t) lim_d P_log(τ > d | OO), where q_OO(t) = (8/t) Σ_{sqrt(x)<n≤x, word₂(n)=OO} 1/n = 1 + O(exp(−c t)); it is not exactly the conditional probability alone. A time-bounded live-count rate r gives ψ_F(t) = O(t^{−r+ε}) after weighted dyadic summation. The two-way decomposition gives φ_F(t) ≤ φ_F(t/2)/2 + (1/3+o(1)) φ_F(3t/4) + ψ_F(t)/4 + exponentially small error. If ψ_F = O(t^{−r}), it proves φ_F = O(t^{−a}) for every a < min(r,e_crit), where 2^{e_crit}/2 + (1/3)(4/3)^{e_crit} = 1. No endpoint exponent or matching lower bound is asserted. The ideal coefficient 1/4 is a separate model. For a uniform majorant E_d(y) ≤ K 2^{κd} y^{1−δ₀2^{−cd}} above a depth-independent threshold, cC < 1 is precisely the criterion for that majorant to give arbitrary logarithmic savings at d = C log₂ log y; failure of the criterion does not lower-bound the actual discrepancy or exclude other proof methods. All parity and live-pressure hypotheses remain unproved. No termination theorem is claimed.

Phase-0 direct estimates of live pressure P_θ and no-momentum M_{θ,q} (Tao note §10, Paper C §9). Route A, last-even reset of the tilted odd share: s_θ ≤ 1/2 + μ_k/2 if complementary cylinders split at 1/2. Fair-coin tilted walk-live μ_4 leaves q_★ ≈ 0.57 below p_19 = 0.598 at the Tao depths, so there is numerical room at k = 4; μ_3 does not (q_★ ≈ 0.61). The complementary term is not Paper B: a high-walk start-cylinder ending in E has a sparse forward image (OOOE at y = 10^5: 6342 points in a span 6.08·10^8, density 1.0·10^{-5}), not a dyadic interval, so Paper B Theorems 4.1, 4.4 and 4.7 do not apply and the split is H_q at unbounded depth, killed by Tao note §10.4(e). Route B1, forward S-sampling Z_d(y) = e^θ times the live tilted moment of S ∩ I(y), is S-fairness of the live set: already odd generation / J-tao-free-term-is-live-mass. Route B2, walk-live Walsh product: |W_T| ≤ N on |T| ≤ k_0 fixed is e^{O(log d)} = e^{o(d)}; the tail is (1+ρ)^d = e^{Θ(d)} with ρ = tanh(θ/2) ≈ 0.196; two-sided control of the tail is J-tao-cylinder-forms-reparameterization; Vaaler plus van der Corput on the nested-floor phase hits the two-monomial leftover or the Weyl budget cC < 1; Paper B on max T ≤ 4 is §10.4(e). No new sufficient inequality. CLOSE. Not a halt theorem.

Localization of Paper B Theorem 5.3 to the even-block fibers of OOOEE and OOEOE does not meet the T2 target. Those fibers have length Y ≍ P^{5/32}, so Y P^{-1/24} = P^{11/96}. Lemma 3.9's printed trivial bound is P^{89/96}, hence |Ω_V ∩ I| ≤ min(Y, P^{89/96}) = Y at both Y = P^{5/32} and the §7.4 length Y = P^{23/32}, which exceeds the target by P^{1/24}. The printed absolute leftovers P^{7/16} and P^{3/8} also exceed P^{11/96}. Retuning V cannot close both the sublevel length and the piece-boundary sum (σ ≤ P^{-31/48} versus σ ≥ P^{-5/24} at Y = P^{23/32}). The dyadic kernel theorem J-kernel-cancellation is untouched. The free term is untouched. CLOSE. Not a halt theorem.

The exponent walk of any Juggler orbit satisfies u_t = o_t log2(3) - t ≡ o_t · alpha (mod 1), alpha = log2(3) - 1 = log2(3/2), because t and o_t are integers and log2(3) = 1 + alpha. Along a cycle of period L the odd count o_t takes every value 0..o, so the walk values mod 1 are exactly the rotation orbit {j·alpha}, j < o. Largest gap mod 1: 5.194e-6 at L = 478245 (o = 301739), 5.101e-6 at L = 780239 (o = 492276), 5.008e-6 at L = 1082233 (o = 682813). This is Paper A's Ostrowski layer read mod 1; it is not a period bound and not a halt theorem.

log2 log J^t(n) = log2 log n + u_t + eps_t. The one-sided half is the Lean height law (flight note Sec.2, aboveAnchor_height_of_walk); the two-sided half is the Sec.6 transport bound Delta <= 1.05 t / min-state, giving eps_t = log2(1 - Delta_t / log n). Measured on 200 odd starts per scale at 1e12..1e100 while above N0 = 3.5e8: max |eps| = 2.07e-10 in u-units. Transport bound on a hypothetical cycle: 1.72e-4 at n = 3.5e8, L = 780239; 5.13e-6 at n = 1e10. So the exponent walk is the log-log clock of the orbit to well within one unit.

The E-tree of a seed m occupies, at generation k, the integers from m^(2^k) to (m+1)^(2^k) with internal density 2^(-k), hence natural density about 1/m at that scale, for every k. Verified exactly: m = 101, k = 1 gives 101 members at scale 1.0404e4 (density 0.009708); k = 2 gives 1040603 members at scale 1.0824e8 (density 0.009614), against 1/m = 0.009901. The burst scales of a seed are m^(2^k), one per generation.

Write c(x) = log2 log x. The scales carrying E-tree bursts of a backward-closed class are c(m) + k over its seeds m and k >= 0, so the covered scales mod 1 are {c(m) mod 1}. By J-lachesis-walk-rotation and J-lachesis-loglog-clock the cycle states of a Lachesis basin sit at c(n) + u_t, an equidistributed rotation orbit with largest gap 5.101e-6 at L = 780239, far finer than the 1.7e-4 clock defect and both far below 1. A dyadic block is a c-window of width about 1 / log y (1.46e-2 at y = 1e30, 4.34e-4 at y = 1e1000), so some cycle state's pure-E burst lands in every block out to log y = 1/5.101e-6, that is y < 1e85142; beyond that the alpha-gaps reopen. Bursts begin at n^2 (generation 1 of the minimum) and none exist below it; the full rotation is available only once c(y) - c(n) >= 1 + u_max, u_max = log2(ln M / ln n) >= 1 the cycle's walk height (Paper A: M >= (n+1)^2). Hence a Lachesis basin is not lacunary on the range n^(2^(1 + u_max)) <= y < 1e85142: it carries natural density at least about 1/n on every dyadic block there, n the cycle minimum; at n = 3.5e8 the threshold is 1e34 for u_max = 1, 1e69 for u_max = 2, 1e137 for 3. The first draft omitted the threshold. This is the third case, missing from contagion note Sec.5.3, which treats only the single seed (lacunary) and the interval [1, N0] (uniform); for the Lachesis class it upgrades Corollary 4.3 from some y in a range to every dyadic block. No fate is excluded and no period bound moves; not a halt theorem. Consolidated into the contagion note Sec. 5.3 (5 Sep 2026) as the third seed-set case, between the single point (lacunary) and the interval [1, N0] (uniform), with the exact half Lean and the every-block half labelled CONJECTURE there. Paper C is untouched; Paper A is untouched (AGENTS.md forbids editing it from a Phase-0 branch).

A deep natural-density census is the wrong instrument for a Lachesis basin. At density about 2/n, M samples give about 2M/n expected basin members, so a census of M samples tests cycle minima only up to about M; the depth needed to clear fair-coin survivors is 527 at M = 3.5e9 and 743 at M = 1e13 (scale 1e100, exact fair-coin DP). Certifying instead that every n <= M reaches 1 costs M shallow orbits rather than M orbits at scale 1e100, and returns a certificate rather than a statistic. The census is strictly dominated by the floor campaign already parked at 5.54e8. Do not run it.

The two contagion productions are two translations of the log-log clock c = log2 log: E sends c to c + 1 and OE sends c to c + log2(4/3) = 0.415037, using floor(sqrt(floor(n^(3/2)))) = floor(n^(3/4)) (verified on [2, 60000)). Measured contribution of one production step from a single seed m to the natural density of the dyadic block containing its image: E gives exactly 2/m (m times density = 1.9610, 1.9920, 1.9960, 1.9992, 1.9996 at m = 101, 501, 1001, 5001, 10001), OE gives about 0.65/m, ratio OE/E = 0.200, 0.351, 0.325 at m = 1001, 5001, 10001, i.e. about 1/3. So every OE detour costs a factor about 1/3 in block density while buying only a new clock offset. Because the alpha-rotation of J-lachesis-basin-every-block already puts a cycle-state pure-E burst in every block, no OE path is ever needed and none improves on 2/n: there are no special blocks, and Corollary 4.3's amplification is in log-count, not in per-block natural density. Its constant carries the seed's 1/n; the factor (log y)^(lambda - 1) is not an absolute density.

An upper bound on the per-block natural density of a Lachesis basin is the free term psi_F of the exact first-letter decomposition (fate note (6.1)), i.e. the infinite-depth live mass of the OO cylinder (Tao note Prop. 11.1), i.e. the pressure hypothesis. Reason: the even members of the basin at scale y are the E-blocks of its members at scale sqrt(y) (density inherited), the OE-type odd members are the fibers of its members at scale y^(3/4) (Paper B, unconditional), and the OO-type odd members are the odd preimages of its odd images at scale y^(3/2) - the free term; dropping psi <= 1 in (6.1) is exactly the upper recursion for the failure density (Tao note Sec. 11.2). Unconditionally the only upper bound is 1 minus the certified density of R, which is at least log N0 / (2 log y) from the E-tree of [1, N0] alone (contagion note Sec. 5.3) - about 0.06 at y = 1e68 - so the two-sided constraint is 2/n <= density <= 1 - 0.06 there. No new attack is opened; the basin side of Paper D's firewall is crossed only from below.

Per-block law of the E-closure of a finite seed set S: on the dyadic block B the density equals sum over x in S and k >= 1 of |[x^(2^k), (x+1)^(2^k)) meet B| times 2^(-k) / |B|; verified to 0.5 percent (measured/predicted 0.996..1.005) on a 40-seed closure to 4e7. One landing burst from x contributes S/(x B) in (1/x, 2/x], S = x^(2^k); OE bursts land at clock offset log2(4/3), in other blocks (six blocks of the test carry OE density with zero E density), adding 8..32 percent where both land. Hence for a Lachesis basin, whose cycle states land in every block by J-lachesis-basin-every-block, the E-visible density on a block at scale y is at least (1/ln y) sum_{x in C} 1/x and the E+OE part at most (3/ln y) sum_{x in C} 1/x. Finance's Lean inv-sum form (cycleMin_finance_inv_sum: (3^o - 2^L) ln n <= 3^o sum 1/x) gives sum 1/x >= theta(L) ln n, and every state >= n gives sum 1/x <= L/n; floor > cap is the finance kill of the pair (true at n = 1e10, L = 780239). At n = 3.5e8, L = 780239: sum 1/x in [6.83e-5, 2.23e-3], so on the valid range y >= n^(2^(1 + u_max)) the block density is in [2.97e-7, 2.90e-5] at y = 1e100 and [9.89e-8, 9.68e-6] at y = 1e300, against the single-seed 2/n = 5.7e-9 (the first draft quoted 1e12 and 1e68, below the threshold for u_max >= 2; withdrawn). A cycle that barely survives finance has sum 1/x pinned, hence a basin whose contagion-visible density is pinned to within the constant factor. Not a halt theorem; the full basin's density is bounded above only by the free term.

J-lachesis-walk-rotation does not know whether the orbit closes: the clock positions of a divergent orbit's states below y are the rotation orbit {c(n) + j alpha : j <= O(y)}, O(y) the odd count before the walk first exceeds u(y) = log2(ln y / ln n). Its basin has an E-burst in the block at y iff a point of that orbit lies within 1/ln y of c(y) mod 1; sufficient is gap(O(y)) <= 1/ln y, gap(O) the largest gap of {j alpha mod 1 : j <= O}, non-increasing in O. Thresholds O*(y) = min {O : gap(O) <= 1/ln y}: 40 at 1e12, 146 at 1e30, 252 at 1e50, 305 at 1e68, 358 at 1e100, 1635 at 1e300, 12275 at 1e1000 (O gap(O) swings between 1.26 and 6.56 with the continued fraction of alpha, three-distance). The gate is meaningful only for u(y) >= log2 3, i.e. y >= n^3: the hug band [0, log2 3) is the minimal invariant band of the walk (Lean hug_band_step_exists, narrow_band_dead, dead_zone_nonempty), and below 1 no even step is possible and at most one odd step fits (no_even_step_below_one, odd_steps_below_one_le_one), so for y < n^3 every orbit has O(y) <= 2 < O*(y) and no basin is every-block there; at n = 3.5e8 the 1e12 row (u = 0.49) is vacuous. Translated to the orbit: it must reach u(y) in at least O*(y) odd steps, so its odd share up to scale y must lie in the window (q*, s*(y)) with s* - q* = 0.0049 at 1e12, 0.0039 at 1e68, 0.0040 at 1e100, 0.0002 at 1e1000. The all-odd rate 0.585 is far outside the window at every scale. The p = 19 hug near-return rate, theta_19 / 12 = 0.00163 walk per odd step, is inside up to 1e300 but outside at 1e1000, where the gate is 0.00056; the p = 84 rate theta_84 / 53 = 5.7e-5 is inside everywhere tested (p = 1054 gives 9.5e-8). So the gate tightens with y and pushes a persistent escaper down the near-return spectrum 19, 84, 1054, ... - the cycle-period ladder of flight note Sec. 6. A Clotho basin is every-block at scale y exactly when the divergent orbit is a critical-share escaper up to that scale hugging a deep enough near-return - the kind the flight extract lets persist; a fast escaper has a lacunary basin, like a single seed. The density is then about (K / ln y) times the partial inverse sum over the states below y, K in [1, 3]; that partial sum is at least 1/n and, unlike the cycle's, is not pinned by finance. Excludes no fate; not a halt theorem.

Hypothesis: recurrent hug domination (flight note Sec. 5.5) forces O(y) >= O*(y) at every scale for every persistent divergent orbit, so that every Clotho basin is every-block unconditionally. Refuted twice. Structurally: every flight-note law bounds escape from below - a_k >= hugOdds(k) (aboveAnchor_prefix_odds_ge_hug), u_k >= 0, u_k >= log2(log x_k / log n), hug excess to infinity, linear peak growth - and none bounds it from above; the gate O(y) >= O*(y) is an upper bound on escape speed and nothing in the laboratory supplies one. Empirically: on the seven canonical high-flyers, at the first passage of every recorded decade from 1e6 to 1e5000, the gate is never met; the walk gain per odd step at passage is 0.08..0.58 against gates of 0.0006..0.04, between 28 and 650 times too fast (slowest passage: 1122603 at 1e5000, O = 67 odd steps in 96, gain 0.145, 240 times the gate 0.0006; 48443 reaches 1e5000 in 31 steps with 26 odd). Random odd starts near 1e6 never meet it either. So the Clotho every-block statement (J-clotho-basin-every-block-criterion) stays conditional on slow escape, and slow escape is neither forced nor observed: a persistent thread whose basin is every-block would be unlike every flight ever realised. Excludes nothing; not a halt theorem.

fract_mul_sub_nat_eq_fract_mul_sub_one: for every real x and naturals o, t, Int.fract (o x - t) = Int.fract (o (x - 1)). Instance fract_walk_eq_fract_rotation: the exponent walk walk o t = o log2 3 - t satisfies Int.fract (walk o t) = Int.fract (o alphaClock) with alphaClock = log2 3 - 1 = log2 (3/2); corollary fract_walk_depends_only_on_odd_count: two prefixes with the same odd count have the same walk mod 1 whatever their lengths. So along any orbit - cycle, divergent, or terminating - the walk values mod 1 are the rotation orbit {j alphaClock} indexed by the odd count. The exact half of J-lachesis-walk-rotation; the gap sizes of the rotation orbit remain a computation. No sorry.

even_chain_mem_burst: if the first k states of the orbit of n are even and floorPower^[k] n = m, then m^(2^k) <= n < (m + 1)^(2^k); proved by induction from the one-step cell Nat.sqrt n ^ 2 <= n < (Nat.sqrt n + 1) ^ 2 (sqrt_cell) and floorPower_even_eq. Corollary even_chain_log_offset (1 <= m): 2^k log m <= log n < 2^k log (m + 1), i.e. in the clock c = log2 log the chain sits at offset exactly k above [c(m), c(m+1)). This is the interval half of J-lachesis-etree-density; the count of the chain (about m^(2^k - 1) even integers) is not formalized. No sorry.

Open statement with a recorded obstruction. A rate on the hug-excess divergence a_k - hugOdds(k) -> infinity (flight note Sec. 5.4) would bound O(y) from above and, by J-clotho-basin-every-block-criterion, make every Clotho basin provably lacunary - cycles every-block, escapes lacunary. The only rate the laboratory has is pigeonhole: a descent-free flight with walk in [0, B) has distinct states in [n, n^(2^B)), so it leaves the band or cycles within n^(2^B) steps; at the hug band B = log2 3 that is n^3, about 4e25 at n = 3.5e8, against a gate O*(y) of 40..12275. Linear peak growth (max x_j >= n + k) reaches walk log2(1 + log(1 + k/n)/log n), negligible for k << n. A usable rate would say that no descent-free flight keeps odd share <= s*(y) for about 1.6 O*(y) = 2..10 ln y steps: a single-orbit parity statement at depth about ln y, exponentially deeper than the depth log log y wall of the Tao reduction, on exactly the pointwise object averages are silent about. Not opened as a branch; the evidence (seven high-flyers 28..650x above the gate) says the statement is true and the method to prove it is not in the laboratory.

WalkStep u v := v = u + alphaClock or v = u - 1. hug_band_step_exists: from any u in [0, 1 + alphaClock) some step stays in the band. narrow_band_dead: if w - alphaClock <= u < 1 then no step from u stays in [0, w); dead_zone_nonempty: for 0 < w < 1 + alphaClock such a u exists in [0, w) - so the hug band [0, log2 3) is the minimal invariant band of the exponent walk. no_even_step_below_one and odd_steps_below_one_le_one (from half_lt_alphaClock, i.e. 9 > 8): below 1 no even step is possible and at most one odd step fits. Supporting bounds one_lt_logb_two_three, logb_two_three_lt_two. These are the exact reasons the Clotho every-block gate is vacuous for y < n^3 and the Lachesis bursts begin at n^2. No sorry.

Inside the hug band the parity letter is forced. band_step_forced_odd: from u < 1 a step staying in [0, 1 + alphaClock) must be the odd one, v = u + alphaClock (the even step goes negative). band_step_forced_even: from 1 <= u it must be the even one, v = u - 1 (the odd step exceeds the band). band_successor_unique: a band-confined walk has exactly one admissible successor at every point. So the walk of a band-confined orbit is the lift of the rotation by alphaClock and its parity word is the mechanical (Sturmian) word of that rotation - the hug itinerary - determined by the starting walk alone, with no freedom. No sorry.

How long a descent-free flight can stay in the hug band [0, log2 3) is the hug-prefix-realization question, already CLOSE (juggler_hug_prefix_realization). By J-loglog-clock-band-word-forced-lean the band word is forced, so staying in the band for L steps means realizing one specific prefix of length L - the mechanical word of the rotation by log2(3/2). The recorded census says the extremal hug cylinder tracks 2^(-L) on [3, 2e8] with fill to depth 28, and log2(2e8) = 27.6: band residence is exactly the fair-coin maximum log2 N over N starts, with no anomaly. The pigeonhole bound of J-clotho-hug-excess-rate (a flight with walk in [0, B) has distinct states in [n, n^(2^B)), hence leaves or cycles within n^(2^B) = n^3 steps at the hug band, about 4e25 at the floor) is therefore off by the whole scale: reality is log2 n, roughly 28. The residence question is not a new branch and must not be reopened as one; the missing object remains a rate, not a bound.

not_reachesOne_even_chain_ge: if n >= 1 does not reach 1 and its first k states are even, then 261^(2^k) <= n. Proof: the k-th iterate is again a failure (backwardClosed_iterate with reachesOne_backwardClosed), hence >= 261 by the Lean floor (reachesOne_of_lt_two_hundred_sixty_one via not_reachesOne_ge; positivity by floorPower_iterate_pos), and the even chain multiplies exponents (even_chain_mem_burst). At the certified floor N0 = 3.5e8 the same argument gives (N0 + 1)^(2^k) (verified computation, not Lean): the failure set is purely odd on (N0, (N0+1)^2), and its E^k-cylinder is empty below (N0+1)^(2^k). The depth-k form of the fate note's 'min F is an OO-start'. Not a halt theorem; F is not shown empty.

One visibility law for the three fates: for a backward-closed class with seed set S0 (its minimal elements), the E-visible natural density on the block at scale y is about (K / ln y) times the sum of 1/x over the seeds whose bursts land there, K in [1, 2]. Atropos: S0 = [1, N0], bursts tile, sum about ln N0 = 19.7, density about 0.06 at 1e68 - contagion note Sec. 5.3's log N0 / (2 log y) recovered. Lachesis: S0 = the cycle, a rotation orbit with gaps 5e-6, sum in [theta(L) ln n, L/n] by Lean finance, density [4e-7, 4e-5] at 1e68 for y >= n^(2^(1 + u_max)). Clotho: S0 = the orbit's states below y, a rotation orbit of length O(y), every-block only under slow escape. The certified floor's own E-forest is therefore 1e4..1e5 times more visible than any finance-surviving cycle at every block: the quantitative reason the census sees R and nothing else. Everything here bounds fate classes from below; the upper bound is the free term (J-lachesis-upper-bound-free-term), and nothing moves the pressure form. A persistent slow escaper sits at odd share in (q*, q* + 0.004), on the pressure threshold from above, measure zero as a single thread.

Reduction of the missing escape rate to a bound on record gaps. Let a divergent orbit from anchor n have record (tail-minimum) gaps at most P and walk gain per record at least theta_min. Records have strictly increasing walk - they are tail minima and the height law is two-sided there (flight note Sec. 6) - so reaching walk u(y) = log2(ln y / ln n) costs at most u(y)/theta_min records, hence at most P u(y)/theta_min steps, hence O(y) <= q* P u(y) / theta_min odd steps: a bound of order log log y. The every-block gate of J-clotho-basin-every-block-criterion needs O(y) >= O*(y), and O*(y) >= ln y with no computation (O points cut the circle into O gaps summing to 1, so gap(O) >= 1/O, and gap(O*) <= 1/ln y forces O* >= ln y). Since log log y = o(log y) the gate provably fails for all large y: bounded record gaps imply that Clotho basin is lacunary above an explicit scale. With the observed constants P = 90, theta_min = theta_19 = 0.0195500, n = 3.5e8, the crossover lies between 1e10000 and 1e20000. Caveat: P and theta_min are coupled, since a longer gap admits a smaller lattice value (theta_19 = 1.96e-2, theta_84 = 3.01e-3, theta_1054 = 6.30e-5), so P / theta_min(P) grows fast - 972 at P = 19, 27884 at P = 84, 1.67e7 at P = 1054 - and the crossover scale explodes with P. The reduction holds for every fixed P; the hypothesis is not proved.

Record structure on the seven canonical high-flyers, along the descent-free prefix: record density 0.204..0.644 (mean gap 1.57..5.04), largest gap 90, and the minimum walk gain per record over all seven is exactly theta_19 = 12 log2 3 - 19 = 0.0195500, the shortest near-return of the log2 3 lattice - flight note Sec. 6's quantization appearing in the record structure rather than being put there. Gap multiset over all seven flights: 1 (150 times), 3 (29), 6 (10), 9 (6), 11 (3), 14 (2), and 19, 25, 28, 52, 90 once each. Among 2316 random odd starts near 1e6 with a descent-free prefix of length at least 20, the largest record gap is 128. So the hypothesis of J-clotho-record-gap-reduction holds on every flight observed; it is not proved, and it is the same single-orbit kind of statement as the rate it replaces. Prefixes are short (45 to 137 steps on the high-flyers), so nothing here says gaps stay bounded as flights lengthen.

Call two starts cothread when their forward orbits eventually coincide; determinism makes this an equivalence and the divergent set is the union of the thread basins. Those basins are disjoint (a start in two would force the threads to coincide) and each is backward-closed and nonempty, so Theorem 4.2 of the fate-contagion note applies to a single thread, not merely to the divergent set: every divergent thread separately has basin log-count much greater than (log x)^0.448. Corollary 4.4 states this only for the union, so the per-thread form is strictly finer. It gives no bound on the number of threads: disjointness plus total log-count log x allows the sum of the constants to grow like (log x)^(1 - lambda), the constants are seed-dependent with no uniform floor (a thread of minimum n_i contributes only about (1/n_i) log log x from its E-forest, far below (log x)^lambda), and disjoint basins do not force disjoint burst intervals - two E-trees may interleave inside one interval with disjoint integer sets. One escaping thread and infinitely many are equally consistent with everything recorded. Not a halt theorem.

The free term psi_F of the exact first-letter decomposition is the infinite-depth live mass of the OO cylinder (Tao note Prop. 11.1): it measures 'never descends' and nothing else. F is the disjoint union of the Lachesis and Clotho parts, so psi_F = psi_{F_L} + psi_{F_C} additively, but neither summand is distinguishable within psi_F - both consist of starts with tau = infinity, the only predicate the free term sees. That is why the Tao reduction settles termination without ever needing the trichotomy. The complement is J-fate-visibility-one-law: natural density on a dyadic block does separate the fates, through the seed set and the rotation. Two instruments with exactly opposite resolution; nothing here moves either, and the pressure form is untouched.

Even steps never deepen the Juggler floor tower. For every j, Nat.sqrt^[j] x = s iff s^(2^j) <= x < (s+1)^(2^j) (sqrt_iter_eq_iff); on an even run floorPower is iterated Nat.sqrt (floorPower_iter_of_even); an odd step followed by j even steps equals Nat.sqrt^[j+1] (n^3), i.e. floor(n^(3/2^(j+1))) with one floor and no nesting (floorPower_odd_even_run, floorPower_odd_even_run_eq_iff); the OE fiber of FateContagion is the case j = 1. Hence the orbit value after a word is a nested tower with one level per odd letter and exponents 3/2^(j_r+1) fixed by the even runs: the tower height is the odd count, not the depth. Kernel-checked; axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only.

Pricing of the good-base reset of the tilted odd share s_theta. The depth-one parity sum has a main term, and the Juggler odd branch cancels it in every harmonic. The van der Corput B-process dualises F(M) = alpha M^(3/2) to -4 nu^3/(27 alpha^2), a cubic with rational coefficient, so the dual sum is a complete cubic Gauss sum on every period; at alpha = 1/2 the modulus is 27, the sum is 9, and |sum_{M<=X} e(M^(3/2)/2)| = (4 sqrt8/27)(3/4)^(3/2) X^(3/4)(1+o(1)) = 0.27217 X^(3/4), measured 0.2701, 0.2707, 0.2721, 0.2719 at 1e5, 1e6, 1e7, 5e7. The parity of floor(M^(3/2)) is biased toward even by 0.425 X^(3/4), entirely on even M. For every odd harmonic k the parity twist moves the stationary points to half-integers and, 2 being invertible mod 27k^2, the twisted and untwisted complete sums coincide (C_k = 9k for 3 not dividing k, C_9 = 0), so all X^(3/4) terms cancel on odd M; with the B-process remainders and Erdos-Turan at H = X^(1/2) this gives #{n <= X odd : floor(n^(3/2)) odd} = X/4 + O(X^(1/2+eps)) (HUMAN PROOF sketch), against the O(X^(3/4)) of the second-derivative test that is attained over even n. Measured, the odd-restricted harmonic sums are 1.3-3.4 X^(1/4) for k = 1,3,5,7 and the parity imbalance over odd n is 30, 146, 210, 16 at 1e5-5e7. Tower levels 2-4 over odd starts to 1e7 carry only sqrt-order imbalance. The arithmetic tier of this row is now machine-checked in formal/Problems/Juggler/DepthOneMainTerm.lean (row J-depth-one-arithmetic-layer): the rational-cubic dual, the complete cubic sum 9, the affine invariance behind the odd-start cancellation, and the constant in the exact closed form sqrt6/9. What stays HUMAN PROOF is the analytic tier: the B-process remainders and the Erdos-Turan step, hence the asymptotic and the X/4 + O(X^(1/2+eps)) count. Exact and depth-one only. CLOSE. Not a halt theorem.

The arithmetic tier beneath J-depth-one-main-term, machine-checked. (a) dual_phase: for the phase F(M) = alpha M^(3/2), at the stationary point M_nu = s^2 with s = 2 nu / (3 alpha) (stationary_point) the Legendre value alpha s^3 - nu s^2 equals -4 nu^3 / (27 alpha^2), a cubic whose coefficient is rational whenever alpha is; at alpha = 1/2 it is -16 nu^3 / 27 (dual_phase_half), so the dual modulus is 27. dual_phase_rpow states the same with the half-power written as a real power, alpha M^(3/2) - nu M at M = (2 nu/(3 alpha))^2, via rpow_three_halves_of_sq. This is where the exponent 3/2 enters: its dual exponent is the integer 3. (b) completeCubicSum_eq_nine: sum over r < 27 of e(-16 r^3 / 27) = 9 exactly, with e(theta) = exp(2 pi i theta). The proof is structural, not a numerical evaluation: every term is zeta^(11 r^3 mod 27) for zeta = e(1/27) (dual_term, zeta27_pow_mod), nine residues cube to 0, and the eighteen others fall into two triples in arithmetic progression of common difference 9, each killed by 1 + zeta^9 + zeta^18 = 0 (zeta27_nine_sum, since zeta^9 is a primitive cube root of unity). (c) depthOneConstant_eq_sqrt_six_div_nine: the constant (4 sqrt8 / 27)(3/4)^(3/2) that the note prints and measures to four digits is exactly sqrt6 / 9 = 0.2721655..., a closed form the note does not record; depthOneConstant_eq_printed ties the definition to the printed half-power form via rpow_three_halves. (d) sum_affine_reindex with two_isUnit: a complete sum over ZMod n is unchanged by x -> u x + c for a unit u, and 2 is a unit modulo 27 k^2 for every odd k, which is the step the note calls '2 nu + 1 runs over a complete residue system' and is the mechanism that cancels the two X^(3/4) terms over odd M. The character convention matches CircleMethod.e on prove2.me, so the statements port in both directions. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only. The asymptotic itself (B-process remainders, Erdos-Turan) is not asserted here and stays with J-depth-one-main-term.

The tilted momentum that the conjecture's failure forces. Theorem 9.2 and Proposition 9.3 of Paper C are unconditional and J-tao-rate-implies-conjecture is a theorem, so if the conjecture is false then for every C and q, infinitely often in y, (1/d) sum_{t<d} (s_theta(t) - q)^+ >= m(C,q) - o(1) with m(C,q) = [D(p_C||q) - e* ln2/C]/c_theta, e* = 1 - lambda** = 0.5074, theta the re-centring tilt log(p_C(1-q)/(q(1-p_C))), using theta p_C - ln a_{theta,q} = D(p_C||q). The margin is exactly 0 below the laboratory's least C for each q and positive from it (least_C_pressure: 19, 41, 214 at q = 0.5, 0.55, 0.6), grows with C, and tends to D(log2/log3||q)/c_{theta_inf,q} = 6.62% at q = 1/2 (0.58% at C = 20, 4.49% at C = 50). The pressure census depth 40 is C = 76 at 1e12 (margin 5.25%, resolution +/-0.06) but C = 15.6 at 1e50 and 11.3 at 1e100, below the least C, where the margin is zero: at those scales the observation cannot bear on M_{theta,q}. Seeing the required momentum needs depth >= 50L and resolution below 4%, and observes only the contrapositive. CLOSE. Not a halt theorem.

Paper C Proposition 9.3 on the word-weight framework of RateFreeDensity. For a nonnegative word weight mu with WeightSplit (each word's two children carry at most the parent's weight) and x >= 1: the tilted generating function Z_d = weightGen mu x d satisfies Z_{d+1} <= Z_d + (x-1) oddMass_d (weightGen_succ_le) and Z_{d+1} <= Z_d (1 + (x-1) s_d) with s_d = tiltedShare mu x d = oddMass_d / Z_d (weightGen_succ_le_share); for 0 <= q, 1 + (x-1)s <= a_q exp(c_q max(s-q,0)) with a_q = 1 + (x-1)q, c_q = (x-1)/a_q (one_add_le_exp_excess); hence Z_d <= Z_0 a_q^d exp(c_q sum_{t<d} max(s_t - q, 0)) (weightGen_le_pressure), and with weight_markov the mass of words with at least k odd letters is at most that over x^k (count_le_pressure). This is the reduction M_{theta,q} => P_theta => Tao-type count, kernel-checked; axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only. Also: NoMomentum mu x q delta d := sum_{t<d} max(s_t - q, 0) <= delta d is the hypothesis as a Lean proposition, and count_le_of_noMomentum gives the Tao-type count <= Z_0 a_q^d exp(c_q delta d) / x^k under it; tilt_exponent_eq_kl shows that at the re-centring tilt x = p(1-q)/(q(1-p)) the per-step exponent p log x - log(1 + (x-1)q) equals the relative entropy p log(p/q) + (1-p) log((1-p)/(1-q)), so the exponent of the count is d D(p||q) minus the excess term. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only.

The live count liveCount N0 N w = #{n in [1,N] : itinerary n |w| = w and n, J n, ..., J^|w| n all exceed N0} is a WeightSplit weight (liveWeight_weightSplit: the two one-letter extensions have disjoint live classes inside the parent's), and juggler_count_le_of_noMomentum instantiates the chain on it: if NoMomentum (liveWeight N0 N) x q delta d holds, then #{n in [1,N] : live for d steps, oddCount(itinerary n d) >= k} <= N a_q^d exp(c_q delta d) / x^k with a_q = 1 + (x-1) q, c_q = (x-1)/a_q. The fibrewise identity liveCount_sum_oddCount writes that count as the sum of live counts over the words with at least k odd letters. So the no-momentum hypothesis is now a proposition about itineraries of floorPower, not about an abstract weight. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only.

Mean-share form of the no-momentum hypothesis. MeanShare mu x q d := sum_{t<d} s_t <= q d, with s_t the tilted odd share of the WeightSplit weight mu at tilt x. Then (weightGen_le_of_meanShare) Z_d <= Z_0 a_q^d with a_q = 1 + (x-1) q and no exponential slack, by the product form Z_d <= Z_0 prod_{t<d} (1 + (x-1) s_t) (weightGen_le_prod) and AM-GM (prod_le_mean_pow, Jensen for log); hence (count_le_of_meanShare) #{o_d >= k} <= Z_0 a_q^d / x^k, and on the live count (juggler_count_le_of_meanShare) #{n in [1,N] : live for d steps, oddCount >= k} <= N a_q^d / x^k. NoMomentum mu x q delta d implies MeanShare mu x (q + delta) d (meanShare_of_noMomentum), so the mean form is the weaker sufficient hypothesis: Paper C's M_(theta,q) bounds the positive excursions sum (s_t - q)^+; only the depth-average of s_t is needed, and depths with share below q compensate depths above it. The difference is depth-to-depth variation only, since s_t already averages over all starts at depth t. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only.

What the mean-share hypothesis does not need, machine-checked. Paper C section 9.3(a) and 9.3(b) were prose; these are the statements. (a) MeanShareOff mu x q d E := sum over t in [0,d) minus E of s_t <= q |[0,d) minus E|, with nothing whatever assumed on the exceptional set E. Then weightGen_le_of_meanShareOff gives Z_d <= Z_0 x^|[0,d) cap E| a_q^|[0,d) minus E|: each excluded depth costs exactly one factor of x and nothing more, because a single letter multiplies the tilted moment by at most x (tiltedShare_le_one). count_le_of_meanShareOff and juggler_count_le_of_meanShareOff carry it to the Tao-type count and to the live count of Juggler starts. meanShareOff_empty: the empty exceptional set is MeanShare, so this is a strict weakening of J-mean-share-form, which is itself a weakening of Paper C's M_(theta,q). (b) initial_depths_are_free: taking E to be the first k depths, no assumption at all on those depths costs more than the constant factor x^k, so every fixed-depth split, the depth-five one included, cannot bear on the reduction. This is why bounded-depth cylinder work is not a route, stated as a theorem rather than a warning. (c) tower_ratio_lt_one with tower_tolerance_half: an all-odd tower splitting with odd share beta at every level carries relative tilted weight (beta x / a_q)^t, so it is free exactly when beta < a_q/x; at q = 1/2 the threshold is (1+x)/(2x) = (1 + e^-theta)/2, which is the 0.836 the note quotes at theta_19. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only.

Phase-0 classification of transfer-weight invariants for the four-step tilted moment of the live pushforward W_t (not the BT tail-reverse operator). The exact four-step number is the word expansion of W_t, equal to the TiltedShare product, and contracts when Z_{t+4}/Z_t <= a_θ^4. A one-sided bound on the W_t-mass of EOOO, OEOO, OOEO, OOOE, OOOO forces that inequality only if the rest is worst-case two-odd; at θ_19 that cut is 1.117 μ_OOOO + 0.449 μ_3-odd < 0.0749, which is stricter than the fair-coin five-word share. Mass, max-atom, collision energy and ancestry multiplicity supply only location-free bounds μ(S) <= 1, μ(S) <= n_S max-atom and μ(S) <= sqrt(n_S E); without a bound on n_S = number of atoms in S none of them meets the cut. On the OOOO cell four odd steps are injective (odd_preimage_unique): the normalized atom profile, energy and ancestry are relabelled while tilted mass grows by e^{4θ} ≈ 2.04 a_θ^4, so every concentration statistic saturates. Through an OE collision, even_preimage_iff puts unboundedly many odd-dyadic starts onto arbitrarily large favorable targets (preimage span 3, 6, 14, 29, 62 at M = 10, 10^2, 10^3, 10^4, 10^5; ancestor counts 3, 9, 21 at the favorable targets 2001, 20001, 200001). Relative mass of one target is small, but every bounded-multiplicity or support-local capacity dies. Controlling where the atoms sit is the good-base / sparse high-walk image already classified as H_q at unbounded depth (J-pressure-direct-routes, J-tower-absorption) or the L^2 / pair-correlation form (J-tao-cylinder-forms-reparameterization). A 1000-start pushforward at N0 = 260 has ratio_4 <= 0.904; that is an observation, not an invariant. No new sufficient inequality. CLOSE. Not a halt theorem.

Exact run inequalities, with no height-to-alphabet conclusion. odd_run_upper: if the first r iterates from v are odd, y = T^[r] v satisfies y^(2^r) <= v^(3^r), an UPPER growth bound, not (3/2)^r <= log M/log m. even_run_contracts: under the stated even-iterate condition, z^(2^g) <= w. oo_step_lower: if x and T(x) are odd and T(x) >= 8, then x^9 < 2(T^2(x)+1)^4; retain the factor two and shift. oddCount_le_of_noAdjOdd: a linear word with no adjacent odd letters has 2 oddCount w <= |w|+1. ee_forces_fourth_power: two even steps give (T^2(w))^4 <= w. These are the quantified Lean statements. The former factor-free maximum, exact cycle closure, odd-run cap, and R<27/8 two-block alphabet are withdrawn; actual cycles have positive floor drift. Conditional zero-drift word algebra is separate in J-cycle-band-discrepancy. The dossier gives the human cycle interpretation m^9 < 2(M+1)^4 at the certified floor, not M >= m^(9/4). No cycle exclusion or termination result. CLOSE.

Conditional abstract word identities, not actual cycle geometry. walk_eq_discrepancy assumes L>0 and o alpha = (L-o) beta and proves o_t alpha - (t-o_t) beta = (alpha+beta)(o_t - t o/L). Without that supplied closure the drift term (t/L)(o alpha-(L-o) beta) must be retained; no log R = log 3 Delta identity for actual Juggler cycles is claimed. band_min_needs_three_climbs: if prefixNoncontracting ((OOE)^k ++ OE ++ v), then k>=3. band_min_no_second_fall: prefixNoncontracting ((OOE)^3 ++ OE ++ OE ++ v) is impossible. These results assume the displayed prefixes and do not derive an alphabet or force the first fall after exactly three climbs. The former height-to-band and forced-fourteen-letter claims are withdrawn. Prescribed-word necklace counts remain finite computations in a separately labelled idealized model, not part of this Lean claim. CLOSE.

The depth-one parity sequence a(k) = floor((2k+1)^(3/2)) mod 2, the letter after the odd step from 2k+1 (oddCubeParity_eq_floorPower: it is floorPower (2k+1) % 2), contains every binary word of length at most six, and the words of length 3, 4, 5, 6 are exhausted at exactly 18, 48, 169, 574 terms: factorCount (parityPrefix 574) 6 = 64 and factorCount (parityPrefix 573) 6 = 63 (factorCount_six_saturates, factorCount_six_not_before, kernel decide; standard foundations only). The finite part of the complexity profile; it says nothing by itself about growth.

The depth-one frontier parity over odd starts, a(k) = floor((2k+1)^(3/2)) mod 2, is not an automatic sequence in any numeration system. Its factor complexity satisfies p(L) >= R(L) >= sum over odd r with 2r+2 <= L of (2r+1) = L^2/8 - O(L), where R(L) counts the interior equal-interval rotation words j -> [{y + j beta} >= 1/2]. Proof: on a window of length L, f(k+j) = f(k) + j f'(k) + rho_j with 0 <= rho_j <= 1.5 L^2/sqrt(2k+1) (f'' = 3(2k+1)^(-1/2) positive decreasing), so once (f(k), f'(k)) mod 2 lies in a cell shrunk by epsilon > 1.5 L^2/sqrt(2k+1) the window is the rotation word of that cell; (f/2, f'/2)(k) mod 1 is jointly uniformly distributed by Weyl's criterion and Boshernitzan 1994 (a f + b f' is a Hardy function of polynomial growth, at distance >> x^(1/2) from every rational polynomial; KNOWN, boshernitzan-1994-hardy-fields), so every interior rotation word occurs with positive lower density; and the 2r+1 shifts of (0^r 1^(r+1)) for odd r are interior rotation words, pairwise distinct and distinct across r through the length of a complete run. Consequences (KNOWN inputs, allouche-shallit-2003-automatic-sequences Ch. 10): q-automatic sequences have p(L) = O(L) (Cobham), Sturmian words p(L) = L+1, codings of one rotation by two intervals linear complexity; none applies, so Walnut-style or Ostrowski-automatic decision procedures cannot settle frontier-parity questions for the Juggler map, at depth one already. COMPUTATIONALLY VERIFIED (N = 3,000,000, L <= 22): p(L) = 2^L for L <= 6, then 126, 229, 390, 618, 932, 1354, 1885, 2586, 3469, 4551, 5885, 7525, 9450, 11719, 14367, 17453; R(L) = 28, 48, 72, 108, 152, 208, 272, 356, ..., 2168 and the periodic family are contained in the factor set at every L <= 22; the control floor(k sqrt 2) mod 2 has p(L) = 2L exactly. OBSERVATION: log p/L falls 0.693 -> 0.444 and log p/log L = 3.16 at L = 22 with local slope 4.2 on [11,22] (rotation words alone 2.99); the factor set is dominated by early, high-curvature positions (p(12) = 1354 from the start, 544 from position 10^5, against R(12) = 356). The reduction is depth one only: the letter after OO is a nested floor and not a Hardy function. Negative knowledge; CLOSE.

The OE fiber of a perfect cube is full or exactly alternating. For every a >= 1 and every n with (2a)^4 <= n and n^3 < ((2a)^3+1)^4, floor(n^(3/2)) = Nat.sqrt (n^3) is even (even_cube_fiber_full); for every odd n with (2a+1)^4 <= n and n^3 < ((2a+1)^3+1)^4, Nat.sqrt (n^3) + (n - (2a+1)^4)/2 is odd (odd_cube_fiber_alternating), so consecutive fiber elements have opposite image parity. Both rest on the integer identity Nat.sqrt ((k^4+t)^3) = k^6 + 3k^2 t/2 for 3t <= 4k (cube_fiber_sqrt_even, cube_fiber_sqrt_odd, by Nat.eq_sqrt and nlinarith from the two square inequalities: n^3 - q^2 = (3/4)k^4 t^2 + t^3 >= 0 and (q+1)^2 - n^3 = 2k^6 + 3k^2 t + 1 - (3/4)k^4 t^2 - t^3 > 0), together with cube_fiber_range: 3t <= 4k on the whole fiber, since 3t >= 4k+1 gives (3k^4+4k+1)^3 >= 27(k^3+1)^4. The range bound is attained (3 t_max = 4k for many k) and the identity itself outlives the fiber to t < 1.63k. Mechanism: n^(3/2) = k^6 (1 + t/k^4)^(3/2) = k^6 + (3/2)k^2 t + (3/8)t^2/k^2 - ..., and the quadratic term stays below one on the fiber; the parity of k^6 + (3/2)k^2 t is 0 for even k and 1 + t/2 for odd k. So m = 10^6 = 100^3 has a full fiber (67 of 67), and every odd cube splits exactly in half. Mathlib's three axioms only. Now Lemma 4.7 of Paper C, with the Lean names in its Appendix A. Remark 4.8 there identifies the window's centre arithmetically: alpha_m = 0 exactly means 27 m^2 = 8 k^3, whose integer solutions are m = (2e)^3 and k = 6e^2, so the even cubes are the exact-solution locus of a Mordell-type equation and the extreme fibers are its near-solutions, spaced asymptotically m^(1/3) apart with about (3/2) M^(2/3) below M. The two sides differ in strength: the full side contains this proved infinite family, while an empty fiber needs a near-miss plus a phase condition and whether there are infinitely many is open. A standing caution: the fiber of a cube is deterministic, not a coin.

Paper C Lemma 4.5 and Corollary 4.6, corrected 9 September 2026. For H_m ≥ 2, let α_m be the centered residue of (3/2)m^{2/3}, β_m = α_m(H_m−1), θ_m = {n_1^{3/2}/2}, and S(β,θ) the measure of s in [0,1] with {θ+βs+s²/3}<1/2. Then G_m/H_m = S(β_m,θ_m) + O(H_m^{−1/2} + (1+|β_m|)/H_m). The square-root error covers tangencies of the quadratic phase to a discontinuity; the old global O(1/H_m) claim is retired. The estimate is useful on restricted drift ranges, not for arbitrary β of order H. The θ-average of S is 1/2; extreme values 0 or 1 are possible precisely for β in [−5/6,1/6]; the β-integral of the phase measure of S=0 is 25/108. The archived code uses beta_hat = αH rather than the corrected lemma parameter α(H−1), so its fit statistics are observations of that convention. A weighted mean share 1/2 is sufficient for a fair production; conditional equidistribution of θ is sufficient under the required error control and is not necessary. No distribution law on a fate class is proved.

Paper C Lemma 4.1 (sweep). Let x_0 < x_1 < ... < x_{H-1} be reals with consecutive gaps in [a, b], 0 < a ≤ b ≤ 1/2, b ≤ (21/20) a and (H-1) a ≥ 12. Then at least H/7 of the terms have {x_j} < 1/2 and at least H/7 have {x_j} ≥ 1/2 (sweep_fract_lt_half, sweep_fract_ge_half); with the left-open half-cells (k/2, (k+1)/2], i.e. the representative x - ceil(x) + 1 in (0, 1], at least H/7 have representative ≤ 1/2 and at least H/7 have representative > 1/2 (sweep_rep_le_half, sweep_rep_gt_half). Both are instances of sweep_cell: each residue class of the half-cell index floor(2x_j) mod 2 holds at least H/7 terms. Proof as in the paper with one simplification: every cell holds at most G = floor(1/(2a)) + 1 terms (fiber_card_le), every strictly interior cell at least g = floor(1/(2b)) (fiber_card_ge), the number of visited cells T is at least 25 (cell_span), one colour has at least (T-3)/2 interior cells (colour_cells_ge, via Int.Ico_filter_modEq_card), and 3g ≥ G (three_g_ge, the paper's case analysis on X = 1/(2a)); the integer chain 42 Good ≥ 21 g (T-3) ≥ 7 G (T-3) ≥ 6 G T ≥ 6 H closes. The left-open variant is the closed one applied to j ↦ -x_{H-1-j} (Finset.sum_range_reflect). Kernel-checked, axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only. Lemma 4.1' (monotone pairing, H/3 - 2) is not formalized. Not a parity theorem about the Juggler map; the fiber inputs (Lemma 4.2) stay human proofs.

Paper C Lemma 5.1 (recursion lemma). Let e_i ∈ [e_min, e_max] with 0 < e_min and e_max < 1, c_i real, λ > 0 with ζ := Σ_i c_i e_i^λ - 1 > 0, t_1 > 0, c_0 > 0. Let g : ℝ → ℝ satisfy g(t) ≥ Σ_i (c_i - η_i(t)) g(e_i t) - η_0(t) for all t ≥ t_1, where 0 ≤ η_i(t) ≤ c_i, Σ_i η_i(t) e_i^λ ≤ ζ/3 and η_0(t) ≤ (2ζ/3) c_0 for t ≥ t_1, and g ≥ c_0 on [e_min t_1, t_1]. Then g(t) ≥ c_0 t_1^{-λ} t^λ for all t ≥ e_min t_1 (recursion_lemma). The proof is the paper's induction on N over [e_min t_1, t_1 e_max^{-N}], with exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one supplying N. Weaker hypotheses than the paper's: e_min, e_max are bounds rather than the extrema, λ < 1 and g ≥ 0 are not needed. Kernel-checked, axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only. This is the abstract analytic step of Theorem 5.3; the three-source inequality (5.2) and its constants stay human proofs. The seed (Lemma 5.2) is Lean, row J-fate-seed. Not a density theorem, not a halt theorem.

Paper C Lemma 5.2 (seed). Every nonempty backward-closed A with a positive member contains some m ≥ 3 (exists_ge_three_of_backwardClosed: 1 maps to 2 maps to 4 through even blocks). For any such m and every y ≥ (m+1)^4, the log-mass of A on (√y, y] is at least c_A = (1 − 2/m^4)(3/8 · 1/(m+1) − 1/((m+1)^2 − 1)) (seed_lemma), and c_A > 0 (seed_constant_pos). Proof as in the paper: the even-block tree S_k of m lies in A and in [m^{2^k}, (m+1)^{2^k}); its log-mass grows by at least 1 − 2 m^{-2^k} per level; the product is at least 3/4 by the geometric series 1/(m^2 − 1) ≤ 1/8; at scale k = log2 log_{m+1} y the tree splits at floor(√y) into members above √y, members whose even blocks lie there, and at most one member equal to floor(√y). The integer form y = floor(x) is the paper's g_A(log x). Kernel-checked, axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only. This is one hypothesis of Theorem 5.3; the production inequalities stay human proofs. Not a density theorem, not a halt theorem.

Paper C Proposition 6.3(i) and the first-letter trichotomy of Section 6.2. If some positive n does not reach 1, the failure set has a least positive member (exists_minimal_failure), and that member is odd with an odd image, i.e. an OO-type start (minimal_failure_odd_odd): an even member n ≥ 2 has the smaller positive member floor(sqrt n) (floorPower_even_lt), and an odd member with even image has the smaller positive member floor(sqrt(floor(n^{3/2}))) < n (floorPower_odd_even_two_step_lt). Stated for any forward-closed class excluding 1 (minimalMember_odd, minimalMember_image_odd). For a two-way closed class A, A n iff exactly one of: n even with J(n) ∈ A; n odd, J(n) even, J(n) ∈ A; n odd, J(n) odd, J(n) ∈ A (first_letter_trichotomy, first_letter_pieces_disjoint) — the three pieces of the identity (6.1).
